title: S1gns Of L1fe app — Vault item
description: One piece of free bonus content shown in the app's Bonus Vault. Publish a list of these under the "vault" key of content.json.

id.description: Unique, permanent identifier. Lowercase letters, numbers and dashes. Never change it once published — saved items and NEW badges are tied to it.

kind.description: Decides how the item looks and what its main button does.

category.description: Filter chip the item appears under (e.g. Tutorials, Sample Packs, Presets, Articles). Items without a category are grouped by kind.

summary.description: One or two sentences shown under the title and in search.

body.description: Long-form text, one string per paragraph. Supports **bold**, *italic* and [links](https://...).

mediaURL.description: The main file or page. video: .mp4/.m3u8/.mov file or a YouTube/Vimeo/Wistia page. audio: .mp3/.m4a/.wav file. pdf: .pdf file. download/link: the page to open. article: the original post (optional).

youtubeId.description: 11-character YouTube video id. Required for kind youtube; on other kinds it adds a 'companion tutorial' player.

thumbnail.description: Cover image — a full https:// URL (or an image name bundled in the app). YouTube items use the video thumbnail automatically.

images.description: Image URLs for kind gallery (the first one is also used as the cover if there is no thumbnail).

attachments.description: Extra files or links listed under 'Included'. PDF links open in the in-app reader.

size.description: Human-readable size or note, e.g. "48 MB".

tags.description: Shown as chips and used by search.

publishedAt.description: Date the item was released: YYYY-MM-DD (or YYYY-MM / YYYY / full ISO-8601). Newest items appear first; items from the last 6 months get a NEW badge until opened.

duration.description: Running time for video/audio, e.g. "23:21" or "1:05:00".

featured.description: true puts the item in the big 'Featured drops' carousel at the top of the Vault.
